notes.title: First post-release patch
notes.notes:
This is the first patch, fixing some issues which we encountered in the first amazing week after release!

[b]Kill Log[/b]
[list]
[*]We updated the kill logs appearing on the right screen side. Now if some players already reached the goal, the kill logs no longer overlap with their playernames
[/list]

[b]Horns & Spamming[/b]
[list]
[*]We had some few players, who made good use of honking the sh*** out of their horns :D Although this is kinda funny, we wanted to do something about it, in consideration of the mental health of our players. So now as soon as a player reaches the goal, he cannot honk anymore
[*]And further we added the mute function. By entering /mute in the chat window, you can mute a specific player. Then you won't see any of his chat messages, and you won't hear him honking anymore.
[/list]

[b]Steam invites[/b]
[list]
[*]It was possible, to break people's steam client by inviting them ~1000 times per second. This should not be possible anymore, thanks to a little invite colldown :)
[/list]

[b]Maps[/b]
[list]
[*]We fixed the start boxes of many maps. It was possible, to bulid black holes or magnets very close to the start. So players got sucked or pulled or even died due to deadly obstacles, which were placed very near to the starting box. This should now not be possible anymore
[/list]

[b]Weather[/b]
[list]
[*]We reduced the brightness of the sun in some weather settings, since it was blooming all over the place. Let us know, if you are still being blinded, then we reduce that even more ;)
[/list]

[b]Player Level[/b]
[list]
[*]We increased the maximum player level, since some players have already reached the previous maximum level. Now this shouldn't be a problem anymore for a long time ;D
[/list]


We're now working on some more bigger fixes and content, so stay tuned, and happy chaos :)

notes.title: AAAAAAAAAH IT'S RELEASE
notes.notes:
Ladies and Gents,

After two centuries of development, Cube Racer 2 is finally being released to the world and steam. And it is [b]Free to play[/b]! Without any strings attached whatsoever. Woooooow

Without further ado, download, play and have fun!

notes.title: We've got a release date: 09.03.2022
notes.notes:
[h1]It's time![/h1]

On [b]March 9th[/b] we will finally release Cube Racer 2! We've gathered a ton of feedback in the last couple of months in our alpha testing phase. The game is now more polished than any player can hope for, while still providing the [b]most satisfying chaos[/b] possible.

If you want to sneak peek the game, try out the still available demo version, and if you like this masterpiece of a game, we will greatly apprieciate you [b]whishlisting[/b] the game. Also tell your friends about it, play with them, and let them whishlist it as well. We want to see our servers burn on release date...

Although we're nearing the release date, leave us any feedback and comments you have, either on our development discord or in the community page here. We read everything, promise!

See you no later than [b]9th March[/b] in the most chaotic but cleanest release ever.

[b]Cheers[/b]

notes.title: Summer Update
notes.notes:
Welcome to this summer update v0.166

We've been working on this big update the last couple of weeks, and just released it with some fixes today. It introduces the new gamemode called "Skill Boxes", where you play with collectable skills every round. Below you can find the complete changelog for this update

[b]New gamemode: Skillboxes[/b]
[list]
[*]At every checkpoint, 4 skillboxes spawn and can be collected, dropping a random skill for the player
[*]The gamemode can be voted to active, or you can now queue with the desired gamemode settings (See below)
[/list]

[b]Gamemode settings in lobby[/b]
[list]
[*]Before you queue, you can now select all gamemode settings you want to play with
[*]If no matching server is found, you will be put into an empty server, with all the gamemode settings you entered
[/list]

[b]Ingame[/b]
[list]
[*]When all players are stuck at the same position, a skillbox with an explode skill will spawn at the last checkpoint after 3 minutes. One player can use it, to blow up the difficult part
[*]When a player uses his skill, an animation will pop up on the left side of the screen for all the players to see
[*]Added explode skill (finally)
[*]When spectating a player, your camera now follows the camera of the spectated player
[*]Added free-cam mode when spectating players
[*]While you are frozen, you cannot use any skills
[/list]

[b]Obstacles[/b]
[list]
[*]New obstacle: Magnet
[*]New upgrade obstacle for Portal
[*]New upgrade obstacle for Wrecking Ball
[*]New upgrade obstacle to Axe
[*]The strong button trap version was made more expensive, from 13 to 27
[*]When a player gets pushed off the track, or boosted into something deadly, the touched obstacles no longer give helpfull points, but instead will be counted as deadly points
[/list]

[b]Maps[/b]
[list]
[*]Added new map with built-in funnel and summersault
[/list]

[b]Skins & Horns[/b]
[list]
[*]Added 4 new horns
[*]Added a new skin
[*]New season pass has been added
[/list]
